audit_scope: Source boundary map only. No new callback implementation or saved-level fixture is claimed.

functions.observed_behavior: Validate the Arguments vector and numeric Value, call Character::GetSkillIDFromOID(int), then append its result. The helper scans the selected SkillList member IDs and returns the matching list index, or -1. This does not read saved skill levels.

Validate the numeric skill-list index, query GetCharSkill(index), then SG_GetSkillLevel(index), and append the saved level. Character::SG_GetSkillLevel reads Character+0x14e8; a null savegame pointer returns -1. No source starter level is supplied by this callback.
Read Character+0x1068; values below zero or greater than/equal to SkillListTable count select row 3. The raw source property is CharacterProperties.SkillTree (property ID 28).
Resolve the selected SkillList row and index to its cached SkillTable projection. _GetCurrentSkillInfo uses this as the reached index/row validation before reading the saved level.
Read Character+0x14e8; return -1 when null, otherwise forward the unsigned index to PlayerSavegame::SG_GetSkillLevel.

properties.name: SkillTree
properties.role: Selects SkillList; class/source property, not the saved per-skill level.

properties.role: Selects FaeryList; separate from ordinary skills.

properties.role: Runtime skill-script property; not the PlayerSavegame level store.

properties.role: Runtime skill-script property; not the PlayerSavegame level store.

source_producers.skill_list_selector: Character::GetCharSkillListId reads the source Character+0x1068 field; current Player projection uses the live PropertyState's resolved SkillTree property 28 and retained SkillTables. Invalid selector fallback row 3 is source-defined.
source_producers.saved_level: Character+0x14e8 points to the PlayerSavegame owner. PlayerSavegame::initialize_skills receives the actual selected SkillList IDs and starts a newly-created save's rows at level 0; the real named Skills profile section then overwrites matching rows. The native Player path currently has no selected PlayerSavegame owner or loaded profile section, so it cannot expose a saved level.
source_producers.mana_helper: The cached skill _commons writes CalcManaCost into the shared skill VM. The current global audit shows it is script-defined, not a Character native function. Skill scripts also read GetCurrentSkillInfo and call GetPyStruct, ToFixed, and SetProp; the native Player provider currently fails closed for the unhandled Character callbacks and does not fabricate values.

native_player_boundary.result: The first reached unprovided callback causes the current OnSkillUpdate attempt to fail closed and blocks subsequent attempts. This is not skill-use or mana-cost support.
native_player_boundary.required_for_reuse: Borrow the eventual single PlayerSavegame owner and its loaded saved-skill rows; use the live resolved SkillTree property and retained SkillTables; keep its lifetime through the synchronous skill VM call. Do not add a second save, property, or skill-level store.
